messages.subject: centroid size disparity

Nick

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] centroid size disparity
parts:
Nick,

the morphol.disparity() function in geomorph will work fine for a univariate trait (e.g. CS) as it does for multidimensional shape data. You can use it to calculate disparity for a single group or to compare among groups. Alternatively, it might be more intuitive to just calculate the variance for CS using the R-base var() function. The two will be proportional to each other, of course.

Hope this helps
Antigoni
